fla.gdn2.notes: Current FLA implementation; official NVIDIA reference is tracked separately.

fla.mamba3.notes: Evaluate separately from mobile CPU path; optimized kernels may be accelerator-specific.

fla.mom.notes: May only become internal sub-banks under the canonical memory owner; never a second owner.

fla.cat.notes: CAT is tracked as an upstream paper/model; no public fla.layers class is assumed by the adapter.

fla.flashqla.notes: Tracked from current FLA news; not assumed to be a public layer class.

fla.gluon.notes: Catalog only; not assumed to be a stable fla.layers export.

mamba3_ssm.notes: Portable research reference; verify source locally before promotion.

mamba_official.notes: Full optimized path is accelerator-oriented; upstream currently has open Mamba-3 step/incremental issues worth qualifying before use.

hnet.notes: Candidate for adaptive temporal abstraction, not a memory owner.

atlas_torch.notes: Needs isolated test-time learning qualification and memory ownership review.

titans_pytorch.notes: Unofficial implementation; isolate and qualify before reuse.

nvidia_gdn2.notes: Reference only. Keep outside production/current tree and preserve upstream license terms.

adaptive_hybrid_temporal_credit.purpose: parameter-free age-scheduled blend of HiPPO history and cascading eligibility, early emphasis on polynomial history and later emphasis on long-tail cascade

product_key_sparse_delta_memory.purpose: product-key sparse runtime memory with bounded similarity-gated delta-style writes

mamba3_heavy_tail_activation.purpose: dependency-free implementation of the Mamba-3 heavy-tail activation as an optional parameter-free state-activation candidate

synergy_consensus_feedback.purpose: parameter-free agreement-weighted consensus feedback from existing predictive/world/self/memory/multiscale branches into the next recurrent input; disabled by default pending qualification

efla_exact_delta_integrator.purpose: exact continuous-time scalar integration of the rank-1 delta write step; research-only and disabled by default

delta_product_transition.purpose: candidate state-transition family using products of generalized Householder transforms for improved state tracking without a second recurrent memory owner

delta_mem_online_state.purpose: compact online associative state with delta-rule writes for continual interaction memory

ttt_linear_attention_reduction.purpose: treat KV-binding test-time training as a learned linear-attention family, motivating trunk simplification before adding a second optimizer-like subsystem

raven_sparse_memory_routing.purpose: high-recall sparse memory routing with selective slot updates; evaluated as an architectural reference for the current top-k state router

delta_mem_compact_online_memory.purpose: compact online associative memory/write-strategy family for continual interaction memory

mamba3_state_tracking_reference.purpose: reference family for richer recurrence, complex-valued state tracking and MIMO updates; not copied into default trunk

continued_causal_state.purpose: chunked long-sequence execution with recurrent-state carry and optional truncated BPTT boundaries

runtime_state_fidelity.purpose: explicit serialization of batch-shaped multiscale runtime state so resume preserves causal continuity

standalone_causal_trunk.purpose: single current execution/learning graph with one causal associative state owner and compact predictive projections

unified_associative_substrate.purpose: sparse recurrent associative substrate with independent erase/write gates, online preconditioning, and sequence-local adaptation statistics

compositional_predictive_memory.purpose: historical compositional memory route preserved for evidence/migration only

adaptive_replay_utility.purpose: historical replay selection controller preserved outside current execution

neural_lifecycle_regeneration.purpose: utility- and activity-aware partial rejuvenation of mature low-contribution hidden units to preserve plasticity

homeostatic_neural_gain.purpose: slow non-gradient activity regulation via bounded per-unit gain

adaptive_neural_compute.purpose: difficulty-gated shallow/deep refinement to allocate compute to hard sequence steps

three_factor_fast_synapse.purpose: causal online fast-synapse adaptation via eligibility trace, broadcast prediction error, and modulatory gate

adaptive_linearity.purpose: per-neuron nonlinear/linear interpolation driven by local gradient-flow history

selective_weight_regeneration.purpose: periodic reset of lowest-utility weights using |w*g| utility with optimizer-state reset

fast_slow_synaptic_consolidation.purpose: transfer stable online fast-synapse state into the matched slow readout synapse before clearing fast state

input_dependent_channel_decay.purpose: candidate input-dependent per-channel retention that turns fixed decay into token-conditioned forgetting without adding a second recurrent owner

multiscale_temporal_decay.purpose: multiple short/medium/long retention timescales within one recurrent state via a fixed decay prior plus bounded learned residual

replay_gradient_alignment.purpose: latent-output gradient-alignment signal for selecting replay examples that support the live correction direction

selective_temporal_credit.purpose: parameter-free per-sample surprise-gated eligibility, reducing trajectory-wide credit broadcasting under mixed events

temporal_credit_assignment.purpose: parameter-free online temporal credit through immediate, single/dual/adaptive/cascaded traces and optional event-specific fast synapses

qed_erase_control.purpose: query-derived erasure orthogonal to key direction to reduce stale associative interference

uncertainty_aware_write.purpose: parameter-free channel-wise write reliability using residual-variance tracking; opt-in KDN/OSDN-inspired candidate

independent_erase_address.purpose: query-addressed erase independent of key-addressed write, without a second memory owner

gradient_update_alignment_probe.purpose: diagnose and optionally project the actual post-AdamW probe update against objective-gradient conflicts; candidate-only because optimizer state is not rewritten

gradient_conflict_arbitration.purpose: PCGrad-style conflict resolution among existing objective gradients on a bounded shared-parameter probe

gradient_subspace_protection.purpose: low-rank GPM-inspired gradient projection that protects previously used representation subspaces from destructive updates

sparse_utility_cache.purpose: historical replay utility cache preserved outside current execution

candidate_policy: No candidate promoted without matched baseline, ablation, multi-seed, stress/interference and resource evidence.
notes: V121 is a foundations/correctness pass. Default parameter count remains unchanged.
V120 files remain available as historical release; V120 checkpoint source_version remains loadable.
